$description: The site's design tokens: the base set (everything but the colour roles, which the theme contexts in tokens.light.json and tokens.dark.json supply). W3C DTCG 2025.10, resolved by site.resolver.json. The game has its own, separate system (src/design/tokens.json). Tiers: p.* primitives (private: only tokens may use them), semantic roles and scales, and c.* component tokens. Vendor data: $extensions["site.fluid"].min (a fluid size's value at 360 px, emitted with clamp()) and $extensions["site.unit"] (a number's CSS unit). Build: node scripts/build-site-tokens.mjs. Rules: documentation/site-ui/design-system.md.

p.$description: Primitives: the raw palette and faces. Private: component CSS never reads a --p-* token.

0.$description: Bright white: raised surfaces in light mode

950.$description: Sunk panels on dark; text on light accents in dark mode

stock.$description: Paper stock: warm neutrals from uncoated white to the dark mode's charcoal.

ink.$description: Warm press black: body text on light

chalk.$description: Warm off-white: body text on dark

indigo.$description: The spot ink. Everything you can act on is indigo: links, primary buttons, checked controls, focus.

marigold.$description: The highlighter: marks, selection, the quote rule, bullets, progress. Never text on paper (1.7:1); for type use the deep marigold role, highlight-ink.

smoke.$description: The lightbox's smoke on dark: a deep, slightly warm black scrim and lighter wisps drifting over it.

mist.$description: The lightbox's smoke on light: a paper-white scrim with soft warm-grey wisps drifting over it.

light.$description: Shadow tint on light: warm, never grey

image.$description: Under text laid on a photograph

frost.$description: Frosted glass: the spot indigo, thin, over a blur (the scrollbar handle), and the light catching its rim.

fraunces.$description: Undercase Type, OFL. Soft, warm display serif. The site serves a cut with SOFT and WONK pinned from the axes tokens and opsz and wght kept (scripts/build-site-fonts.py)

newsreader.$description: Production Type, OFL. A text face made for reading on screens, cut to the regular to semibold weights

figtree.$description: Erik Kennedy, OFL. A friendly, clean geometric sans for the interface

mono.$value: ui-monospace, 'Cascadia Code', 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
mono.$description: System monospace: code in the design library only

fraunces-full.$description: The full variable Fraunces (all four axes), loaded only by the design library’s axes playground

font.$description: Three faces, three jobs: display (headlines, quotes, big numbers), text (reading), ui (everything you act on, captions, meta).

display.$description: Headlines, standfirsts, pull quotes, drop caps

specimen.$description: The type playground in the design library: every axis live

axes.$description: Fraunces' variable axes. SOFT rounds the serifs (0 sharp to 100 soft); WONK swaps in the leaning, quirky letters. The site's font files have these values built in (scripts/build-site-fonts.py reads them from here); the settings stay for the library's full-axes playground and as documentation.

display-italic.$description: Pull quotes and standfirsts: soft, with the wonky italics

text.$description: The type ramp. Fixed sizes for the interface; fluid sizes (clamp between a 360 px and a 1280 px viewport) for reading and display. Every max is at most 2.5x its min, so 200% zoom still enlarges text (WCAG 1.4.4).

sm.$description: 14 px: captions, meta, small controls. The floor for functional text

lg.$description: 18 px: large controls, the library's intro

jumbo.$description: 56 to 136 px: section numerals, the index's big type

display.$description: Display and jumbo: close the gaps big type opens

space.$description: A 4 px spacing scale, plus three fluid spaces that carry the whitespace.

block.$description: Between an article's blocks (a figure, a quote)

section.$description: Between a page's sections: the magazine's whitespace

measure.$description: The reading column: about 68 characters of Newsreader at 19 px

popout.$description: Figures that step out of the column

icon-lg.$description: An icon alone in a button

radius.$description: Rounded and friendly, but not one radius for everything: small things are rounder, pictures softly rounded, full-bleed images square.

md.$description: Text fields, the select's trigger, options

lg.$description: Images in an article, cards, the dropdown list

round.$description: Avatars, icon buttons, the slider thumb: the pill radius on a square is a circle

strong.$description: Checked outlines, the current nav item

shadow.$description: Print has no shadows, so they're rare: only things that float above the page have one.

md.$description: The dropdown list, a hovered card

fast.$description: Small controls: a check, a thumb

slow.$description: The lightbox's cross-fade, the carousel's glide

drift.$description: One loop of the lightbox's smoke

spring.$description: A friendly overshoot: a switch's thumb, a check

layer.$description: The z-index scale. Nothing sets a z-index outside it.

minimap.$description: The article minimap: over the article's content, under the header, menus, dialogs and every other floating control

breakpoint.$description: For @media and @container only (CSS can’t read a variable there): tests/unit/siteDesignSystem.test.ts checks every width and height query uses one of these.

short.$description: 480 px of height: a phone on its side (a height query)

c.$description: Component tokens: a component's own decisions, named after it, built from the semantic tier.

height-sm.$description: 40 px (its hit area is padded to 44)

size.$description: 22 px box inside a 44 px row

list.$description: Lists whose items take a background (hover, selected, current): the dropdown’s options, side navigation, menus.

item-gap.$description: The gap between items, so a hovered item never touches the selected one beside it

thumb.$description: The handle: indigo-tinted frosted glass over whatever it floats on

thumb-hover.$description: The handle under the pointer or being dragged

rim.$description: The light along the glass edge

size.$description: 6 px: the handle at rest, floating over the content (no gutter, no arrow buttons)

size-hover.$description: 10 px: the handle under the pointer, easier to grab

inset.$description: The gap between the handle and the edge it runs along

min.$description: The shortest a handle gets, however long the content

blur.$description: The frost: how much the handle blurs what is behind it

saturate.$description: The frost keeps the colour behind it lively

solid.$description: The handle without the frost, for Reduce transparency

column.$description: A collection's narrowest column with a picture, in the Columns layout: below it, the row wraps

row-picture.$description: The width of an item's picture beside its words, in a collection's Rows layout

slide.$description: The width of an item in a collection's Carousel layout (the next one peeks in)

strip-min.$description: In a full-width strip (the carousel, the sideways timeline), the narrowest an item shrinks to so the row fits the window and is centred; below it, the strip scrolls

prominent-bg.$description: A prominent tile's surface: the accent's soft tint, a step up from the raised paper (never inverted)

prominent-edge.$description: The accent edge down a prominent tile's start side

prominent-ink.$description: A prominent tile's labels and quieter lines: the accent's ink, readable on its soft tint

timeline-when-width.$description: In a collection's Timeline layout on a wide screen, the column of times before the line (a longer time wraps in it)

timeline-mark-size.$description: The round mark on a timeline's line, one for each item

timeline-gutter.$description: The lane a timeline's line runs in, with its marks centred in it

timeline-slide.$description: The width of an item, the line's run to the next mark included, in a collection's sideways timeline

timeline-picture.$description: The widest an item's picture shows in a collection's Timeline layout, under its words

timeline-line-width.$description: The thickness of a timeline's line

timeline-line.$description: A timeline's line: a rule, so more contrast strengthens it

timeline-mark.$description: A timeline's marks: the marigold highlighter, a printer's mark (the time beside it carries the meaning)

timeline-when.$description: An item's time: marigold as type, dark enough to read

cell-min.$description: A table column's narrowest width: below it, the table scrolls sideways in its frame instead of squeezing its words

row-heading-min.$description: The narrowest width of a table's first column when it names each row

cell-max.$description: On a phone, a table column's widest: each column takes its words' width up to it, and the table scrolls sideways

row-height.$description: The common height of every row in a justified gallery

row-height-small.$description: The common height of every justified gallery row on a phone

placeholder.$description: Where a picture will be, while it loads (and if it can't)

shimmer.$description: The light that sweeps across a picture's place while it loads

shimmer-cycle.$description: One sweep of the loading shimmer

fade-in.$description: A loaded picture fading in over its shimmer

portrait.$description: The width of a page's portrait beside its title (a résumé, About); smaller on a phone

portrait-sm.$description: The width of a page's portrait on a phone, above its title

shadow-y.$description: How far a picture's drop shadow falls below it (when a page turns it on)

shadow-blur.$description: How soft a picture's drop shadow is: it follows the picture's own shape, transparent parts and all

cap.$description: Fraunces' cap height as a part of its size (measured: 49 px at 68 px, 28 px at 40 px): a contents entry's numeral drops by half the difference of the two cap heights, so it centres on its name's capitals instead of sharing only its baseline

height-compact.$description: 56 px: the header on a phone, upright or on its side

secondary.$description: A duotone icon's second layer: the spot indigo under the ink of its first (which takes the text colour), like a two-ink print

secondary-opacity.$description: The second layer as a solid spot colour, the way a two-ink print lays it

tonal-opacity.$description: A tonal icon (a status, an icon on an accent or marigold fill, forced colours): both layers in the text colour, the second this strong

thumb.$description: A filmstrip frame's width (3:2, so 53 px tall: still a full touch target)

thumb-on.$description: The ring round the slide being shown

thumb-rest.$description: A frame not being shown, dimmed so the one that is stands out (full on hover)

peek-scale.$description: A neighbouring slide, peeking: a little smaller than the one being shown

peek-min.$description: The least of a neighbour that shows when there is no room beside the carousel (a phone keeps none)

play.$description: The play button on an embedded video's poster: large enough to read as the way in from across the page

play-icon.$description: The triangle inside the play button

card-min.$description: The narrowest a story card gets in an index's grid before the grid drops a column

row-picture.$description: The picture at the end of a row in a section's list view

row-picture-compact.$description: The row's picture on a phone, so the title keeps most of the width

editor.$description: Edit mode's own dimensions (the local CMS). Written to editor-tokens.css, which only the editor imports: none of these reach a production page

outline.$description: The article editor's outline of blocks

inspector.$description: The article editor's inspector (the block's and the page's settings), as it starts and at its narrowest: one column of every section in turn

inspector-max.$description: The widest the inspector can be dragged; from 40 rem (the sm breakpoint, as a container query) it's two columns, the sections listed beside the chosen one's fields

inspector-nav.$description: The wide inspector's list of sections, beside the chosen one's fields

canvas-min.$description: The least the canvas keeps beside a widened inspector

context-menu.$description: The editor canvas's row and column context menu: wide enough for every action label without wrapping

device-tablet.$description: The canvas at tablet width (768 px)

device-phone.$description: The canvas at phone width (390 px)

thumb.$description: The narrowest a picture gets in the media library's grid

section-list.$description: The Sections and Planet screens' list of sections (or buildings), beside the selected one's pages and settings

access-list.$description: The Access screen's list of access codes and magic links, beside the chosen one's details: room for a name, its kind and organisation, and its dates

scope-list.$description: The tallest the list of sections and private pages a code or link opens grows before it scrolls on its own

crop-stage.$description: The tallest the crop dialog shows its picture

upload-preview.$description: The tallest the upload form previews the picture it's about to upload

crop-veil.$description: How strongly the crop veils what it leaves out: the page's smoke, at this opacity

crop-handle.$description: A crop handle's mark (its target is the touch size)

width.$description: 52 px: the strip, room for the longest pill at 150%; it takes pointer input only inside itself

width-touch.$description: 60 px: the strip on a touch screen

inset.$description: Between the strip and the edge of the scrolling area: clear of the page scrollbar (6 to 10 px wide, 3 px in)

gap.$description: The space between two pills (8 px): a 12 px row

row-touch.$description: The least a row is on a touch screen: 24 px (the WCAG 2.5.8 minimum for a target)

bar.$description: A pill: 4 px thick, at rest, hovered or current alike (only its length changes)

bar-1.$description: A level-1 heading pill (when the title is not the page title): 32 px

bar-2.$description: A level-2 heading pill: 24 px, three quarters of level 1

bar-3.$description: A level-3 heading pill: 18 px, three quarters again

bar-5.$description: A level-5 or 6 heading pill: 10 px

media.$description: A picture, gallery or carousel: the same pill, one length (16 px); only headings vary, by level

touch-scale.$description: Marks on a touch screen: a little larger, keeping the differences between kinds and levels

tick.$description: A mark at rest: one soft neutral for every kind (the tooltip and the name tell them apart)

active.$description: The indicator under the pointer or focus (wins over current)

magnify.$description: How much longer the active pill gets: to 150% of its length (its three neighbours each side less, like a dock); never thicker

current-grow.$description: The current pill takes this share of that growth (to 115%)

tip-max.$description: The tooltip’s widest (also capped by the viewport)

tip-gap.$description: Between the tooltip and the strip

edge-zone.$description: 56 px at the strip’s top and bottom where a mouse held still auto-scrolls it

edge-speed.$description: The fastest that auto-scroll moves, per frame

pin.$description: How long a tapped indicator and its tooltip stay (touch has no hover)
